snippet.title: NSMBWii Superstar Mode: Version 2 Demo (Release Trailer)
snippet.description:
This is an Update to NSMBW Superstar Mode Demo that updates a lot of things such as Updated Level Design, Level Add-Ons, New Bonus Areas, Updated Soundtrack & Many More Updates. 


Download: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1KtdeskhRaR8kCfrRR-Wo5dKl4U0Y3INe?usp=sharing

Discord: https://discord.gg/XDsDqZrkra

If you encounter any issues or problems, Please join the server to mention issues.

Credits:
Logo: @JackSnacksOnBigMacs
Tilesets: Newer Team (Newer Assets), B1 Gaming (Updated NSMBW Tilesets), Rimea (BG Rocks & Stars), CodeMorio (Tileset Editing Help)
Music Help: Deku_Knut
Playtesting: Qualiqola, ElectricalSquid, Deku Knut, Boucheon
Level Design Assistance: 5 Points
Updated Text Boxes: Mandy
Star Coin & Castle Gear Model Imports: G4L
Mecha-Koopa Remodel: Atomic Mods



Team:
Violet: @TheFriendshipSaboteurs 
5 Points: @ChagasFivePoints
